title: Phase Seven - Eight
subtitle: Test your grasp of Phase Seven - Eight — E.B.S. truth packages, Whitehat media takeover, Truth Tribunals, and overt liberation of the realm.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Phase Seven - Eight is the culmination of The Great Purge: E.B.S. shatters the 3D illusion, then tribunals and realm security stabilize the aftermath. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Phase Seven - Eight deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Covert neutralization becomes overt liberation—and the realm is secured for crystalline reconstruction and Ascension.

relatedTopic.label: Return to Phase Seven - Eight deep-dive

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “The Great Purge” refers to the aftermath and stabilization period involving public and private tribunals, arrests, and executions of neutralized parasites to prepare the realm for reconstruction.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: False — that description belongs to “Phase Eight”. The report defines “The Great Purge” as: The systematic, top-down removal of the parasitic control structure, beginning with global leaders and moving through infrastructure, culminating in mass public awakening.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “Phase Eight”, not “The Great Purge”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “The Great Purge”.

questions.question: How does Phase Seven fracture the 3D illusion?

options.label: A
options.text: Through a series of newspaper editorials written by Whitehat journalists, which slowly prepare the public for the truth over several years without any broadcast takeover.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Phase Seven initiates the definitive psychological fracture of the 3D illusion through global activation of the E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System).

options.label: B
options.text: Through global activation of the E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System), which starts the definitive psychological fracture of the 3D illusion.
options.rationale: Phase Seven initiates the definitive psychological fracture of the 3D illusion through global activation of the E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System).

options.label: C
options.text: By holding back all disclosure until after the Ascension, so that the fracture happens in the sky rather than in the media.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Phase Seven initiates the definitive psychological fracture of the 3D illusion through global activation of the E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System).

options.label: D
options.text: By handing control of the mainstream media back to its owners, who are made to read the truth on air themselves.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Phase Seven initiates the definitive psychological fracture of the 3D illusion through global activation of the E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System).

questions.hint: Name the global system activated for definitive psychological fracture.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System)” refers to A continuous 72-plus hour global broadcast of truth packages designed to dismantle the 3D illusion and expose the parasite system.

options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System)” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System)” as: A continuous 72-plus hour global broadcast of truth packages designed to dismantle the 3D illusion and expose the parasite system.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System)”.

questions.question: What transition do these final phases create for the public?

options.label: A
options.text: From controlled ignorance into full, undeniable realization of the planetary hijack and its subsequent liberation.
options.rationale: These final phases transition the public from controlled ignorance into full, undeniable realization of the planetary hijack and its subsequent liberation.

options.label: B
options.text: From Ascension completion backward into underground trafficking reconstruction.
options.rationale: Phase Three dismantled underground networks earlier; final phases secure liberation and Ascension prep.

options.label: C
options.text: From full liberation back into deeper controlled ignorance with no hijack realization allowed.
options.rationale: The direction is out of controlled ignorance into realization of hijack and liberation.

options.label: D
options.text: From Trigger Events scare alone into permanent war with no truth packages or tribunals.
options.rationale: Trigger Events prepare Sleepers; Seven and Eight deliver truth packages and justice stabilization.

questions.hint: Move from controlled ignorance to undeniable realization of hijack and liberation.

questions.question: How is The Great Purge defined across the full sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: A cleansing of the banking and media sectors, which leaves the political leaders in place to manage the transition once the money and the messaging have been taken over by the Alliance.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Great Purge is the systematic, top-down removal of the parasitic control structure, beginning with global leaders and moving through infrastructure, culminating in mass public awakening.

options.label: B
options.text: The systematic, top-down removal of the parasitic control structure, beginning with global leaders and moving through infrastructure, ending in mass public awakening.
options.rationale: The Great Purge is the systematic, top-down removal of the parasitic control structure, beginning with global leaders and moving through infrastructure, culminating in mass public awakening.

options.label: C
options.text: A bottom-up movement that starts with street protests and works its way upwards, until public pressure forces the global leaders to step down from their posts.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Great Purge is the systematic, top-down removal of the parasitic control structure, beginning with global leaders and moving through infrastructure, culminating in mass public awakening.

options.label: D
options.text: A single public event in which the parasites' control is ended overnight, with no earlier phases and no need to move through the infrastructure or economy first.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Great Purge is the systematic, top-down removal of the parasitic control structure, beginning with global leaders and moving through infrastructure, culminating in mass public awakening.

questions.hint: Describe top-down removal from leaders through infrastructure to mass awakening.

questions.question: What defines Phase Seven as the disclosure stage?

options.label: A
options.text: Only Mimic Tech replacements with no seizure of narrative channels for disclosure.
options.rationale: Mimic Tech is Phase Four continuity; Phase Seven is public E.B.S. disclosure seizure.

options.label: B
options.text: Benevolent forces seize total control of global media and internet to broadcast undeniable proof of elite crimes.
options.rationale: Phase Seven is the disclosure stage where benevolent forces seize total control of global media and internet to broadcast undeniable proof of elite crimes.

options.label: C
options.text: Only private courtroom notes with no global media and internet takeover in the public eye.
options.rationale: Communications takeover is complete and public; broadcasts run as continuous truth packages.

options.label: D
options.text: Benevolent forces permanently restore corporate media ownership with no elite-crime broadcasts.
options.rationale: Phase Seven seizes media to expose elite crimes, not restore corporate narrative ownership.

questions.hint: Focus on seizure of media and internet to broadcast proof of elite crimes.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

options.label: A
options.text: Phase Seven — The disclosure stage where benevolent forces seize total control of global media and internet to broadcast undeniable proof of elite crimes.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Phase Seven”.

options.label: B
options.text: Truth Tribunals — Public and covert legal proceedings held during Phase Eight to extract confessions and execute justice upon the world's most dangerous operatives.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Truth Tribunals”.

options.label: C
options.text: Phase Eight — The benevolent Earth-based and galactic military forces orchestrating The Great Purge and controlling the awakening narrative.
options.rationale: That description belongs to “Whitehats”. The report defines “Phase Eight” as: The aftermath and stabilization period involving public and private tribunals, arrests, and executions of neutralized parasites to prepare the realm for reconstruction.

options.label: D
options.text: Sleepers — Unawakened human populations trapped in the 3D parasitic overlay, shielded from premature panic by artificial constructs until the final phases.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Sleepers”.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

options.rationale: It is a continuous 72-plus hour global truth-package broadcast, not a brief weather loop.

options.label: C

options.rationale: E.B.S. dismantles the 3D illusion and exposes the parasite system under Whitehat control.

options.label: D
options.text: A continuous 72-plus hour global broadcast of truth packages designed to dismantle the 3D illusion and expose the parasite system.
options.rationale: E.B.S. is a continuous 72-plus hour global broadcast of truth packages designed to dismantle the 3D illusion and expose the parasite system.

questions.hint: Recall continuous multi-day truth packages that dismantle the 3D illusion.

options.text: Unawakened human populations trapped in the 3D parasitic overlay, shielded from premature panic by artificial constructs until the final phases.

options.rationale: Whitehats are the benevolent Earth-based and galactic military forces orchestrating The Great Purge and controlling the awakening narrative.

options.label: B
options.text: Free-energy devices recovered from the underground bases, which are handed to the public after Phase Eight as proof that the parasites hid the technology from them for generations.

options.label: C
options.text: Advanced biological clones, AI-driven digital composites, stand-in actors and holographic projections used to replace neutralized elites and keep up the look of continuity.
options.rationale: Mimic Tech includes biological clones, AI-driven digital composites, stand-in actors, and holographical projections used to replace neutralized elites and maintain the illusion of continuity.

options.label: D

questions.question: What is already true of the most dangerous world controllers before Phase Seven?

options.label: A
options.text: They only appear after E.B.S. as brand-new leaders with no pre-Seven neutralization history.

options.label: B

questions.question: What is Phase Seven’s master-stroke purpose against false reality?

options.label: A
options.text: To shatter false reality in a single blow by overriding mainstream media and exposing global corruption, trafficking rings, and occult control.
options.rationale: Phase Seven is the master stroke to shatter false reality in a single blow, overriding mainstream media to expose global corruption, trafficking rings, and occult control.

options.label: D

options.rationale: Phase Seven is the single-blow disclosure fracture; Phase Eight then anchors and stabilizes.

options.text: The move from covert operations to a long period of Mimic normalcy, in which clones keep the old leaders' roles running while the purge continues quietly behind the scenes.

options.text: The move from covert operations to overt liberation, leaving the realm stabilized, parasite-free and energetically prepared for the reconstruction of the true crystalline world.

options.text: The move into a series of further Trigger Events, which are needed because the realm cannot be stabilized until the parasites' underground networks have been rebuilt elsewhere.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Phase Seven and Eight represent transition from covert operations to overt liberation, ensuring the realm is fully stabilized, parasite-free, and energetically prepared for physical and dimensional reconstruction of the true crystalline world.

questions.hint: From covert operations to overt liberation, stabilized and prepared for crystalline reconstruction.
